title: Site Migration
description: Checklist for migrating a WordPress site to a new host — database, files, DNS, and post-migration verification

steps.title: Put source site into maintenance mode
steps.instructions: Enable maintenance mode on the old site to prevent new content being created during migration. Use a plugin or add define('WP_MAINTENANCE', true) to wp-config.php.

steps.title: Export full database backup
steps.instructions: Export the full database via phpMyAdmin, WP-CLI (wp db export), or UpdraftPlus. Verify the .sql file is not empty and is not corrupted.

steps.title: Copy all files to new host
steps.instructions: Transfer wp-content/ via FTP/SFTP or file manager. Include all themes, plugins, and uploads. Do not copy wp-config.php — create a new one.

steps.title: Create database on new host and import
steps.instructions: Create a new MySQL database and user on the new host. Import the .sql backup. Verify row counts match source.

steps.title: Update wp-config.php on new host
steps.instructions: Set DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_HOST for the new database. Generate fresh salts from wordpress.org/secret-key/1.1/salt/.

steps.title: Run search-replace for new domain
steps.instructions: Run WP-CLI: wp search-replace 'old-domain.com' 'new-domain.com' --all-tables. Or use Better Search Replace plugin. Verify serialised data is handled correctly.

steps.title: Update WordPress Address and Site Address
steps.instructions: Go to Settings > General. Update WordPress Address (URL) and Site Address (URL) to the new domain.

steps.title: Flush permalinks
steps.instructions: Go to Settings > Permalinks. Click Save Changes without changing anything. This regenerates .htaccess rewrite rules.

steps.title: Update DNS records
steps.instructions: Update A record (or CNAME) at the domain registrar to point to the new host's IP. Note: propagation can take up to 48 hours.

steps.title: Verify site on new host and remove maintenance mode
steps.instructions: Test all pages, forms, payment flows, and email on the new host using hosts file or temporary URL. Once verified, disable maintenance mode and confirm DNS has propagated.
